The following events took place in '''27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]] is struck by a bioplague; the nearby [[Avoni]] attempt to conquer it. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] are sent to [[Mission to Radnor|help evacuate survivors]].
*''[[Outbound Flight]]'' departs from [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].
*[[Reija Momen]] becomes administrator of the [[Intergalactic Communications Center]].
*Population of [[Engebo V]] is wiped out by [[skekfish]].
*[[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] [[Skirmish at Coruscant's power core|fight]] [[Ashaar Khorda]] and his followers from using the [[Infant of Shaa]] to destroy [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Poof dies during the battle but prevents Khorda from destroying Coruscant, after the battle Jango Fett returns the Infant of Shaa to [[Seylott/Legends|Seylott]].
*[[Kaeline Ungasan]]'s illegal [[Mining/Legends|mining]] scheme was uncovered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]].<ref name="Hnn-Podracing Faces Uncertain Future">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref>
